一句话作用: Fetch compact TPMI PheWAS summaries for single variants by accepting rsID, GRCh37, or GRCh38 input and resolving to the required GRCh38 query. Use when a user wants concise TPMI association results for one variant
关键输入: - Read one JSON object from stdin, or a single JSON string containing the variant. - Required input: exactly one of rsid, grch37, grch38, or variant - Optional fields: max results, save raw, raw output path, timeout sec - Common patterns: - {"grch38":"6:16054…
关键输出: - Success returns ok, source, input, query variant, max results applied, association count, association count total, truncated, associations, variant, variant url, raw output path, and warnings. - Use raw output path when save raw=true.
